outcome: Rate of deliveries beyond 34 weeks of gestation
Rate of deliveries beyond 37 weeks of gestation
cohort: 201 pregnant women who underwent cervical cerclage (154 elective, 47 emergency)
finding: Pregnancy outcomes, including gestational age at delivery, preterm birth rates, cesarean delivery rates, and birthweight, were comparable between emergency and elective cerclage groups.
mod_finding: The study found no significant differences in pregnancy outcomes, including mode of delivery, between emergency and elective cerclage.
gest_age: Mean gestational age at cerclage operation was 13.1 ± 1 weeks for elective cerclage and 20.2 ± 3 weeks for emergency cerclage
birth_weight: Mean birthweight was 2848 grams for the emergency cerclage group and 2862 grams for the elective cerclage group
